title: Grown-ups buying kids’ toys
questions: What are the main ideas you learned from this episode? Please give a brief summary in your own words.
Why do some adults enjoy buying toys that were originally marketed to children?
Is collecting toys a form of nostalgia, hobby, investment, or all three?
At what point can collecting become unhealthy or financially irresponsible?
Do companies deliberately target adults with products that remind them of childhood?
If you could buy one toy from your childhood again, what would it be and why?
